title: Mt Kodu/Kokoda Track landowner blockade over unpaid PNG government compensation
location: Naoro/Nauro and Kokoda Track, Central Province; exact site extent reported variably, including the 96 km route
public_gathering: Landowner blockade/track closure reported; whether at least 50 people gathered simultaneously is unknown.
domestic_state_demand: Outstanding government commitment/payment for landowners who agreed to forgo the Kodu mining project; demand directed to PNG government/Prime Minister.
continuity: Closure began 16 September, persisted through October, was still indefinite in November, and was lifted/reopened 5 December according to later reports.
notes: Do not count ~50 Australian trekkers turned back as protesters. No landowner attendance count is captured. The blockade may represent a continuing action, not a new October-start event; no October candidate assigned.

start_date.summary: Later official release dates landowner closure to 16 September 2024.

location.summary: Kokoda Track and landowner communities; ABC identifies PNG; later official release names trail landowners.

demand.summary: Search results describe unpaid compensation owed by PNG government.

participants.summary: No count of landowner protesters; tourist counts refer to trekkers and are not reused.
